result.instructions: Tools for Woffu, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the users of our company who are active in Woffu."; "Show the contracts of user 1234 and when each one starts."; "Which departments and offices does our Woffu company have?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Woffu data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run woffu_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run woffu_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run woffu_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. woffu_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: woffu_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the Woffu company. Woffu API: GET /api/v1/users. No paging parameter is sent.

tools.name: woffu_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get one user by UserId: name, company, department and status fields as Woffu returns them. Woffu API: GET /api/v1/users/{userId}.

user_id.description: The Woffu UserId: the internal numeric user id. Use woffu_list_users to find it.

tools.name: woffu_list_user_contracts
tools.title: List user contracts
tools.description: List the employment contracts of one user by UserId. Woffu API: GET /api/v1/users/{userId}/contracts.

tools.name: woffu_list_departments

tools.name: woffu_list_offices
